text:
I was giving those things too much credit. Someone can make enormous progress and still be in pretty rough shape if they started from far enough back. A dramatic meditation or insight interests me a lot less than what happened in their last real conflict.

I’m wary of a flawless autobiography for the same reason. If every ugly pattern ended years ago and every ex was the problem, what am I supposed to learn about being with this person now? I’d rather hear what they still do badly and what might actually be hard about loving them.
